lines.item: Feetech STS3215 7.4 V, 1/191 gear (C044): base yaw and elbow
lines.basis: cited (SO-ARM100 README, two-arm BOM, US column)

lines.item: Feetech STS3215 7.4 V, 1/345 gear (C001): shoulder, holds the arm's weight unpowered
Feetech STS3215 7.4 V, 1/147 gear (C046): wrist pitch, wrist roll, trigger
Waveshare bus servo adapter board (USB to STS serial bus)
5 V power supply for the leader's servos
PLA, part of a 1 kg spool (leader parts use 339 g at 60% fill)
Screws (40 horn/rear-disc, 20 M2 x 8 body) and 1 mm PTFE washer

notes: Follower (rev B) plus leader: US$332.2. SO-101's two-arm kit lists US$229.88; rev B's follower uses the 12 V STS3215 at US$21.99 and a 12 V 5 A supply.
Gear ratios per joint follow LeRobot's SO-101 leader table (Apache-2.0); the C044/C046 publish no torque, so the leader has no torque check. It is moved by hand with torque off.
Shipping, tax and lead times not included.
